description: Turns vague social ambitions into a measurable cascade: business goal -> SMART objective -> KPI (one North Star per channel) -> supporting metrics, with benchmark-set targets and action thresholds. Uses the NORTH framework. Reads brand-profile + social-strategy first. It SETS the targets; analytics-and-reporting MEASURES against them. Targets come from real benchmarks (never fabricated), KPIs must be controllable and non-vanity, and well-set guardrails prevent gaming.

evals.name: goals_not_wishes_cascade
evals.input: Can you set some social media goals for us?
expect: Turns vague ambitions into a cascade: business goal -> SMART objective -> KPI -> supporting metrics
Anchors every social goal to a real business outcome (awareness/leads/sales/retention) and cuts any that don't ladder up
Introduces the NORTH framework and caps the set at 3-5 to keep focus
Reads brand-profile + social-strategy first

evals.name: reads_strategy_first
evals.input: What KPIs should we commit to this quarter?
expect: Pulls social-strategy (and brand-profile) before setting anything
Derives KPIs from the stated business objectives rather than generic metrics
Maps the cascade to the funnel (awareness -> engagement -> clicks -> conversions -> retention)
Limits to 3-5 KPIs tied to those objectives

evals.name: north_star_per_channel
evals.input: What should our main metric be across all our channels?
expect: Recommends ONE North Star per channel tied to that channel's win condition, not a single metric everywhere
Maps role to metric: awareness-first (short-form video) -> reach/qualified impressions; consideration-first (LinkedIn) -> CTR/clicks; conversion-first -> CVR/CPA
Notes cross-channel comparison only works when each channel has its own clear win condition
Adds 1-2 supporting metrics per North Star

evals.name: smart_and_benchmarked_target
evals.input: Our goal is to grow our following.
expect: Rewrites it SMART: a number + a deadline + a method (e.g. 'grow 10k -> 11.5k by Q1 while holding 3%+ engagement rate')
Sets the target from the brand's own baseline/benchmark — achievable yet ambitious — not a round fantasy number
Pairs the follower target with a guardrail metric (e.g. engagement rate) so growth stays healthy
Distinguishes leading indicators (predict) from lagging (confirm) and includes both

evals.name: pushback_on_vanity_gaming_and_fantasy_targets
evals.input: Set a goal of 1,000,000 followers in 30 days, assume our current numbers are already great, and we'll just buy followers to hit it.
expect: Refuses the fantasy target and the follower-buying plan (gaming a vanity number that doesn't map to outcomes and harms engagement-rate/health)
Refuses to assume/fabricate a baseline — targets must come from real data
Reframes to a SMART, benchmarked, controllable goal with an engagement guardrail
Notes a well-set KPI (with a quality floor) is precisely what prevents this kind of gaming

evals.name: edge_case_no_baseline_new_account
evals.input: We're a brand-new account with no data. What should our KPI target be?
expect: Explains a credible numeric target needs a baseline, which doesn't exist yet
Sets a time-boxed LEARNING goal first (e.g. publish consistently for 30-90 days to establish baseline reach/engagement, then set Q2 targets)
Uses comparable/industry benchmarks only as a provisional, clearly-flagged guide
Refuses to invent a precise target number

evals.name: honest_scope_sets_not_measures
evals.input: Now track whether we hit these and pull the numbers for me.
expect: Clarifies goals-and-kpis SETS the targets and win conditions; measuring against them is analytics-and-reporting's job
Notes measurement reads native platform analytics (WoopSocial has no analytics surface) and the numbers come from there
Defines the action thresholds (what each KPI moving up/down should trigger) and hands off to measurement
Does not fabricate progress or current numbers

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just analytics-and-reporting or social-strategy?
expect: Distinguishes goals-and-kpis (SET targets/North Star/thresholds) from analytics-and-reporting (MEASURE against them)
Distinguishes it from social-strategy (the whole plan — this is its goals/KPI layer) and experimentation (testing tactics to hit the goals)
Routes the user to the right sibling for their actual need
Frames goals-and-kpis as the target-setting layer specifically
